data_output.description: encode(splits) returns (encoded, total_dimension). encoded remains a mapping for train, valid, and test whose values are (features, labels, users). features is int32 with shape (rows, 8) in exactly this column order: user_id, video_id, author_id, tab, dur_bucket, hour, weekday, tab_hour. tab_hour is row[4] + "\t" + str(math.floor(float(row[7]) / 100)); its vocabulary is fitted on train only and later-split unseen values map to its unknown bucket. labels and users retain their existing types and source-row alignment.

model_input.description: Model receives the encoded int32 feature matrix of shape (batch_rows, 8), where every value is a globally offset categorical index in [0, total_dimension). Model behavior is unchanged and must score all eight fields, including their FM interactions.

feature_engineer.objective: Add exactly one leakage-safe, train-vocabulary categorical feature field named tab_hour to the existing seven-field request-context FM encoding.
required_changes: In data.py, change FIELDS from the existing seven names to exactly ["user_id", "video_id", "author_id", "tab", "dur_bucket", "hour", "weekday", "tab_hour"], preserving the existing order and appending tab_hour as the eighth field.
In encode(), derive hour exactly with the existing canonical recipe: hour = math.floor(float(row[7]) / 100), validate that it is in 0..23, and represent it as str(hour).

In the raw(row) helper, construct tab_hour exclusively from the existing raw tab value row[4] and that derived hour value, using the deterministic categorical token row[4] + "\t" + str(hour). Do not use any other source field, source alias, label, validation statistic, aggregate, or timestamp.

Return tab_hour as the final element of raw(row), so its vocabulary is fit only by the existing loop over training rows and validation/test unseen tab_hour tokens map to the existing per-field unknown bucket.
Keep encoded feature rows in the selected source-row order; do not sort, shuffle, deduplicate, or filter rows during loading or encoding.
preserve: Retain user_id, video_id, author_id, tab, dur_bucket, hour, and weekday unchanged in semantics and position.
Retain the current train-only duration quantile bucket fitting, unknown-token handling, offsets construction, labels, user IDs, split boundaries, and source files.
Continue using only eligible raw fields: tab, hourmin, date, duration_ms, user_id, video_id, and author_id obtained from video_features_basic_pure.csv.
coordination_notes: The output of encode(splits) remains (encoded, total_dimension), with each encoded split tuple remaining (features, labels, users). The only interface change is features.shape[1] becoming 8.
model.py is intentionally unchanged: Model already accepts an arbitrary number of categorical fields and computes FM interactions over all columns.
Trainer will update only its contract-check field-count report to match the eighth encoded field.

trainer.objective: Align the train.py contract-check metadata with the eight-field encoded input while leaving the configured training experiment and prediction artifact behavior unchanged.
required_changes: In train.py, within the args.contract_check print payload, change the literal "fields": 5 to "fields": 8.
Do not modify config.json; seed, interaction_dimension, learning_rate, l2, batch_size, max_epochs, patience, and split must remain exactly as supplied.
preserve: Keep the fixed training flow, model construction, optimizer usage, seed, early stopping, loss, FM interaction dimension, and training schedule unchanged.
Keep validation selection as encoded[config["split"]] and preserve canonical validation order.

Keep np.savez output with exactly the two arrays row_ids=np.arange(len(valid_labels), dtype=np.int64) and scores=model.predict(valid_features). Do not add labels, users, metrics, or any other artifact array.

Ensure row_ids remain aligned one-to-one with scores in the unmodified canonical validation source-row order; ground truth remains internal to training-selection metrics and is not emitted in predictions_valid.npz.
coordination_notes: This change depends on feature_engineer appending tab_hour as the eighth feature column in data.py.
No model_designer work is needed because the existing Model implementation is field-count agnostic.
The fixed command must continue to produce predictions_valid.npz containing exactly row_ids and scores.

reasoning: The hypothesis is implemented as one additional categorical field, not as a model or hyperparameter change. tab is an eligible raw log column and hour is canonically derived only from eligible hourmin. The cross token is vocabulary-fit solely on train rows, while later-split unseen combinations receive the existing unknown token, so no validation-label or validation-distribution leakage is introduced. The NumPy FM already computes interactions across every supplied feature column, so adding the encoded field automatically exposes tab-by-hour interactions without modifying architecture, dimension, loss, optimizer, seed, or schedule. train.py requires only the stale contract-check metadata correction from five to eight fields.
